# View Source directly loads the palette used by its shared menu styles

This landing adds a direct colors.css link to the View Source document before messenger.css and contextMenu.css. At the fixed accepted revision, messenger.css imports variables.css, whose scoped popup declarations refer to color tokens defined by colors.css. The real View Source context menu belongs to that document. This establishes the explicit stylesheet dependency in this document. The review treats palette-first ordering as an optional readability suggestion; it is not a global CSS ordering rule. Native popup styling, computed colors and the earlier reported transparency were not reproduced.

Scope: View Source theme integration.
